ontology.note: Dedicated semantic contract is not yet registered; do not infer one from the widget title.

changes.description: The Preview counts the candidates a condition keeps, and the distances they give. It restated `distanceSentence(draft)`, which NAMES the conditions being edited and never said what they kept -- so the one number a condition exists to change was available only by running the workflow and reading the receipt. Now `nearestPlaces`, the function the run calls: the eligible count moves as a condition is typed, with the nearest, median and furthest distance, and the points left with no distance at all.

evidence.note:
Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/distances-as-table.test.mjs checks the table and that a table port takes a distances result; tests/sea-level-from-scratch.browser.mjs builds both sea-level workflows on it (Chromium).

THE PREVIEW (2026-11-25). Browser tested on Chromium: tests/measure-distance-preview.browser.mjs drives four candidates to two and then to none, and asserts that every point then reports no distance. NOT established: that the preview's distances equal the run's to the last digit, which would need a test holding both.
